title: asha-patel-soc2-evidence-scratchpad
content:
SOC2 evidence scratchpad - quick personal TODOs and notes

Date: 2024-11-02 (last pass)
Context: Catch-all scratchpad for evidence collection, vendor docs, and policy TODOs. Trying to tidy up before next audit dry-run.

Top priorities (this week):
- Logical access evidence: finish Okta access review exports (need last 6 months). Asked Marcus to run export, waiting on CSV.
- Change management: finalize release window logs for Aug-Oct (apply tags to PRs). PR link: https://github.com/redwood-infra/ansible/pull/89 (need owner signoff).
- Backup & restore: confirm restore test on dev-sql01 done 2024-10-28; need formal test report + screenshots.
- Vendor reviews: Datadog contract & ATO docs - request from procurement to vendor for subprocessor list (deadline 2024-11-08).

Evidence matrix quick status:
- User provisioning (AC-1/AC-2): partial - onboarding runbook exists, but evidence gaps on terminated users (May-July). Action: run terminated-user query + closure attestations.
- MFA coverage (AC-7): mostly covered for SSO apps; exceptions: legacy service accounts (list in jira SEC-412).
- Change control (CM-3): need signed RFCs for three infra changes in Sept. Follow up with Eng-Platform.
- Patch mgmt (SI-2): monthly patch logs exist, but missing CVE tracking doc for Sep. Ask infra on SLA for patch notes.

Vendor review notes:
- Okta: evidence needed = tenant export + policy screenshots + SOC3 if available. Marcus to confirm export schedule.
- Datadog: request for subprocessor list + SOC2 report. Procurement looped (Priya).
- Cloud provider: AWS attestation and config snapshot for cross-account roles. TODO: run iam-summary script and drop into confluence page.

Policy TODOs / drafting
- Update Access Revocation policy to include 48-hour SLA for contractor offboarding (drafted 2024-10-15, needs legal review).
- Add retention clause for diagnostic logs (14 vs 30 days) - sync with Observability team on cost impact.
- Draft note for encryption key lifecycle (KMS/HSM rotation cadence).

Meetings / action items
- 2024-11-04: 30m with Platform Eng (patch mgmt gaps) - prep list of missing months + impacted services.
- 2024-11-06: Vendor review sync (Procurement + Priya + me) - compile pending vendor docs.
- Weekly sync: SOC2 evidence triage (Weds 10am) - bring updated evidence matrix.

Open questions / blockers
- Who owns the PR signoffs for infra changes in Sept? (pinged Marcus, waiting reply).
- Is Datadog willing to share a redacted SOC2? Procurement says likely, timeline uncertain.
- Backup test report format - do we keep as docx or paste into confluence? Auditor prefers PDFs.

Notes to self (quick reminders):
- Save all screenshots to evidence bucket: s3://redwood-audit-evidence/asha/2024-11
- Filename convention: <control>-<yyyy-mm-dd>-<short> (makes indexing easier)
- Add link to confluence evidence index after uploading

Small wins / done:
- Baseline access matrix exported 2024-10-20 and uploaded (partial).
- Restore test completed on dev-sql01 (logs collected).

Next 48h checklist:
- [ ] Chase Marcus for Okta export (CSV)
- [ ] Upload restore test screenshots to evidence bucket and link in confluence
- [ ] Draft vendor request email for Datadog subprocessor list (use procurement template)
- [ ] Update Access Revocation policy doc with 48h SLA and send to Legal

Random notes / snippets to paste later:
- "If vendor cannot provide SOC2, request their ISO27001 + recent penetration test summary"
- "For auditors: provide sampling methodology for terminated users (sample last 12 months)"

References / links to copy into confluence when consolidating:
- JIRA-SEC-412 (terminated users + exceptions)
- confluence:SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Index
- https://github.com/redwood-infra/ansible/pull/89

End of scratchpad. Keep this as living doc - rough, chopped, not for sharing externally.
